items.title: Arsène — creative portfolio
items.summary: A personal space connecting frontend development, storytelling and interaction.
items.role: Creative direction, design and frontend development.
items.context: Personal project: build an online presence that makes my approach to development clear within the first few seconds.
items.challenge: Showcase projects and experience without sacrificing speed, readability or mobile usability.
items.approach: An editorial layout, a bilingual design system, considered interactions and a visual identity built with CSS and lightweight WebGL.
items.outcome: The portfolio is both a showcase and a place to experiment with web interfaces.

items.title: Vodacom Smart Agent
items.summary: An internal interface explored during my internship at Vodacom Congo.
items.context: Internship at Vodacom Congo in Kinshasa. The work involved internal tools related to retail point supervision.
items.challenge: Make operational information easier to browse and understand day to day.
items.approach: Frontend contributions to a supervision interface and digitization initiatives, alongside the engineering team.
items.outcome: An opportunity to work with a product team and learn the constraints of internal tools. Project details remain confidential.

items.title: Remote consultation
items.summary: A final-year project exploring remote consultations and medical follow-up.
items.role: Design and development of a student prototype.
items.context: Final-year project at the University of Kinshasa, focused on access to remote consultation services.
items.challenge: Shape the steps of a consultation and follow-up journey into an understandable application.
items.approach: A web prototype bringing together a React interface, Node.js services and MongoDB storage.
items.outcome: An academic project that let me practise interface design and frontend-to-backend integration.

items.title: Catalog-Service
items.summary: An exploration of a portal for organizing digital services and resources.
items.context: An internal project direction explored during my experience at Vodacom Congo.
items.challenge: Imagine a clear way to discover and present digital tools from a single entry point.
items.approach: A catalogue concept organized around search, categories and service cards.
items.outcome: A design and structure exploration. Internal details are not published.

about.lead: I’m Arsène, a full-stack developer based in Kinshasa. From frontend to backend, I turn real problems into clear, thoughtful and well-built web experiences.
about.story: My mathematics and computer science education sparked a love of problem solving. Work experience taught me to listen, collaborate and deliver with care. I now explore interaction, real-time technology and creative tools for the web.

experienceItems.detail: Contributed to internal retail supervision tools and digitization initiatives.
